target.title: fix(cron): support current and session: targets in initial delivery resolution
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`resolveInitialCronDelivery` in `src/cron/service/initial-delivery.ts` only checks `sessionTarget === "isolated"` when deciding whether to inject default `{ mode: "announce" }` delivery. All other cron code paths already treat `"isolated"`, `"current"`, and `"session:"` as equivalent for this purpose, creating an inconsistency.

## Why This Change Was Made

After #98947 restored persistent session targets, the three sessionTarget values are treated identically in:
- `delivery-plan.ts:106-114` — `isDetachedOutputJob` check
- `normalize.ts:680-684` — `isDetachedDeliveryJob` check
- `jobs.ts:288-298` — `isIsolatedLike` check

But `initial-delivery.ts` was not updated, so cron jobs created with `--session-target current` or `--session-target session:...` would not get the default announce delivery at creation time.

## User Impact

Users creating cron jobs with `sessionTarget: "current"` or `"session:"` may miss delivery announcements.

## Evidence

**Exact head:** `afceffd830f0df94e315326ff8854e3ce99c19a8`

**End-to-end behavior proof (real gateway from the worktree at exact head, repo mock OpenAI, bundled `qa-channel` + in-repo QA bus; isolated `HOME`/`OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR`/`OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH`; no real credentials):** for BOTH `current` and `session:*` targets — CLI `cron add` creation → persisted delivery state (`cron list --json` + SQLite `cron_jobs`: `delivery_mode=announce`, `delivery_channel=last`) → `cron run` execution (the `session:*` job ran inside the persistent session `agent:main:qa-channel:channel:channel:qa-room`) → exactly one observed announcement per job delivered to the session channel (`qa-channel:channel:qa-room`). Full redacted transcripts: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99115#issuecomment-4985152103

**Regression coverage placement:** the direct-service contract is now documented in `src/cron/service/initial-delivery.ts` (supported creation paths fill delivery in `normalizeCronJobCreate`; this helper governs direct-service `CronService.add`/declarative-convergence callers and stays consistent with `src/cron/normalize.ts` + `src/cron/delivery-plan.ts`), with caller-level tests through the public `CronService.add` contract added in `src/cron/service/initial-delivery.test.ts`.

**Validation (exact head):**
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/cron/service/initial-delivery.test.ts --run`: 16/16 passed
- Neighboring cron suites (`normalize.test.ts`, `service.jobs.test.ts`, `service.declarative-jobs.test.ts`, `delivery-plan.test.ts`): 145/145 passed
